title: AI VTuber OBS Scene Mapping Table
description: Operator-owned table from an exact OBS program scene name to a scene class (issue #88 S1, ADR-0007 D-3 rank 2). Serialized form of aivtuber_domain::ObsSceneMap. It is configuration written by the operator, hence trusted; the OBS scene name is only a lookup key and is never copied into a snapshot, a request or a log line. A scene the table does not name is silence, not a guess. Unknown fields are refused. At most 32 scenes; a scene name is at most 128 UTF-8 bytes with no control character (the schema counts characters, the Rust loader counts bytes, so a name of 65 two-byte characters is rejected only by the loader). The whole table is at most 16 KiB, checked before parsing.

scene_class.description: unknown is not a mapping: it would only be silence.

interruptibility.description: What the operator says about interrupting the performer while this scene is live. The operator wrote it, so it may affect busy/deferral (#75); a perceived scene never can.
